en.headline: Blue House lanterns stay up through Mid-Autumn week
en.dek: More than 700 hand-painted lanterns line Stone Nullah Lane and nearby Wan Chai streets until 14 October, with charity stalls on the cluster's open ground from 24 to 26 September.
body: Hand-painted lanterns hung across the Blue House Cluster in Wan Chai will remain lit through Mid-Autumn week, the organisers of the Viva Blue House project said. More than 700 lanterns painted by residents, neighbours, pet owners and about 50 local illustrators are displayed along Stone Nullah Lane, Kat On Street, Hing Wan Street, King Sing Street and Queen's Road East.

The lanterns are switched on from 6pm to 9.30pm each evening and are due to stay up until 14 October. The display, now in its fifth year, began with a lighting ceremony on 28 August. The cluster at 72 Stone Nullah Lane has been conserved since 2016 under a keep-the-house, keep-the-people approach and is still occupied as homes and shops.

Charity stalls are scheduled on the open ground from 24 to 26 September, selling Mid-Autumn handicrafts and pet goods made by members of the cluster's community programmes, with proceeds supporting conservation work, according to the organisers. Lighting may be suspended in poor weather.

Mid-Autumn Festival this year falls on Friday, 25 September. The organisers have also listed a photography contest running into October. Visitors were asked to follow on-site arrangements on the narrow streets around the tong lau.

zh.headline: 灣仔藍屋七百盎手繪花燈亮至中秋
zh.dek: 石水渠街藍屋建築群及附近街道掛上逾700盎街坊及插畫家手繪花燈，展期至10月14日，9月24至26日設慈善攤檔。
body: 灣仔藍屋建築群的中秋花燈將繼續亮至節日期間。主辦的「We嘩藍屋」活化計劃表示，超過700盎由街坊、鄰居、寵物主人及約50位本地插畫家繪製的花燈，懸掛於石水渠街、吉安街、慶雲街、景星街及皇后大道東一帶。
花燈每晚6時至9時半亮燈，展期至10月14日。活動今年踏入第五年，已於8月28日舉行亮燈儀式。位於石水渠街72號的藍屋建築群自2016年活化以來，以「留屋留人」方式保育，至今仍是民居及店舖。
主辦單位表示，9月24日至26日會在藍屋空地設中秋慈善攤檔，義賣社區計劃成員及街坊的手作和寵物用品，收益用作支持保育工作。遇惡劣天氣，亮燈或會暫停。
今年中秋節為9月25日（星期五）。主辦單位另設攝影比賽，截稿期延伸至10月。該處街道較窄，參觀人士須按現場指示行走。
